# Compiler v9 historical writer

Generated with the unmodified `PragmaProjectService.renderProjectFiles` writer and DSL v5 schema archived from commit `1169ba2f`. The synthetic Expert is the same input used by the historical execution snapshot writer. All manifest, resource and lock contents, including SHA-256 fingerprints, are original writer outputs. They were not produced by changing version literals in a current project.

Generation used an esbuild bundle of the archived Interpreter and Shared sources; the output preserves the immutable compiler v9 project while the public migration builds the current compiler view. No credentials or user data are included.
